decisions.reason: The retail system interface plugin has accumulated two years of investment, supports the firm's core integration services, and its weak results can still be attributed to temporary causes, so the firm persists.
The shop relaunch SEO support service is highly visible with its own page, central to the announced direction, and represents a substantial public commitment, so withdrawal is very unlikely.

The SEO workshops are prominently presented and align with the firm's search marketing focus, and although recently launched, the firm is responsible for this public commitment and will likely continue despite early disappointments.
